text:
Ravi (Marketing): Quick thread  ClearRun partnership approved. Proposal: single launch week with 1) marketplace listing push, 2) benchmark blog (latency & cost vs default cloud), 3) 45-min joint webinar + live Q&A, and 4) gated demo downloads. Objective: drive marketplace clicks and net-new MQLs. :loudspeaker:
June (Partnerships): ClearRun asked for co-branded one-sheeter, marketplace spotlight slot, and a 20s explainer video in their listing. They want final assets by Apr 22. Webinar target: May 12.
Alex (Growth): For lead routing: suggest partner_code=clearrun in form, utm_source=clearrun_marketplace, and route leads to queue=partner-inbound. We'll ping eng for a webhook that creates lead + assigns campaign_id.
Tess (Content): I'll own the benchmark post + webinar script. Benchmark plan: 3 load profiles (chat interactive, short completion, long-form), identical model weights, measure p50/p95 latency, token cost using our batching vs their default. Need ENG to run 2 x 5min runs and share traces.
Marco (Sales): Important: SF should get a "Partner Channel" picklist and a boolean "Marketplace Lead". Also add "intent_level" (High/Med/Low). We need those to prioritize SDR outreach.
Ravi (Marketing): Good. Who will produce the video? June? Or partner creative team?
June (Partnerships): ClearRun will produce a rough cut. We will do the final pass and add Redwood branding. June will request assets today.
Alex (Growth): Routing snippet (pseudo) I'll hand to eng: 
``nPOST /integrations/partner-leads
{email, name, partner_code, utm_source, answers: {use_case}}
if partner_code=="clearrun" then tag=partner_clearrun; queue=partner-inbound; campaign=clearrun_may
``nInclude campaign param so analytics can attribute.
Marco (Sales): For qualifying question add: "Primary use case" (choices: product feature, internal tooling, research). Also add "avg monthly token volume" with ranges.
Tess (Content): I'll put CTAs in the benchmark post linking to the gated demo and marketplace listing. Also will draft 3 social tile sizes and a short explainer copy for the listing.
calendar-bot: meeting created: "ClearRun co-marketing kickoff" Apr 5 9:30 AM PT  attendees: Ravi, June, Alex, Tess, Marco.
Ravi (Marketing): Action items: 1) June: confirm video ownership & get partner copy by Apr 12; 2) Tess: benchmark draft + webinar script by Apr 18; 3) Alex: webhook spec + tracking param list by Apr 10; 4) Marco: SF fields + prioritization matrix by Apr 11. I'll assemble the launch checklist and share in kickoff doc.
June (Partnerships): Partner asked if we can do a shared webinar landing page with instant calendar add for registrants. They prefer single co-branded page.
Alex (Growth): That's fine. We'll host the page, but include partner tracking params and their pixel. Need security signoff if they want to add their pixel.
Marco (Sales): If partner sends attendees list post-webinar, we should ingest into SF as "warm" and assign to SDR pool.
Ravi (Marketing): Noted. Add spinner for post-webinar follow-up: 1) send partner thank-you + content pack, 2) pass hot leads to SDRs within 24h.
Tess (Content): I'll produce email copy + 5 follow-up templates tailored to intent level.
Alex (Growth): I'll create a simple Notion spec for the tracking fields and share here: https://notion.so/redwood/clearrun-co-marketing (placeholder).
Ravi (Marketing): Great. If nothing blocks we'll proceed. Ping here if you need approvals or creative reviews. :sparkles:
